{{Infobox football league season | competition = [[Chinese Jia-A League]] | season = 1999 | winners = [[Shandong Taishan F.C.|Shandong Luneng]] | relegated = {{ubl|[[Guangzhou Matsunichi F.C.|Guangzhou Songri]]|[[Wuhan Optics Valley F.C.|Wuhan Hongtao K]]}} | continentalcup1 = [[2000–01 Asian Club Championship|Asian Club Championship]] | continentalcup1 qualifiers = [[Shandong Taishan F.C.|Shandong Luneng]] | league topscorer = [[Qu Shengqing]] (17 goals) | matches = 182 | total goals = 428 | average attendance = 19,909 | prevseason = [[1998 Chinese Jia-A League|1998]] | nextseason = [[2000 Chinese Jia-A League|2000]] }} The 1999 [[Chinese Jia-A League]] season, also known as '''[[Pepsi]] Chinese Jia-A League''' for sponsorship reasons, was the sixth season of professional association football and the 38th top-tier overall league season in China. It was started on March 21 and ended on December 5.
